point: The Large Hadron Collider is an enormous 27-kilometer circular machine representing the biggest scientific experiment ever built.
quote: the lhc is the largest scientific experiment ever attempted twenty seven kilometers in circumference

point: The LHC was designed to replicate the extreme conditions of the infant universe hundreds of millions of times every second.
quote: its job is to recreate the conditions that were present less than a billionth of a second after the universe began

point: The ATLAS detector is an immense instrument built to capture imagery of particle collisions beneath Geneva.
quote: this is the one i work on it's called the atlas detector forty four meters wide twenty two meters in diameter

point: The initial beam run on September 10th was a major triumph that proved the machine worked as intended.
quote: when we saw that picture on september tenth we knew the machine worked which is a great triumph

point: The successful startup created significant cultural awareness alongside its scientific accomplishments.
quote: it means we made cultural impact as well as scientific impact

point: The collider uses superconducting cables chilled to extreme temperatures to carry massive electrical currents.
quote: at minus two hundred and seventy one degrees colder than the space between the stars those wires can take that current

point: A manufacturing defect in a wire connection led to resistance and damage across approximately fifty heavy magnets.
quote: in one of the joints between over nine thousand magnets in lhc there was a manufacturing defect

point: After repairing the damaged magnets, the team prepared to restart the collider to resume gathering universe data.
quote: we will switch it on and we expect to take data in june or july and continue with our quest

point: The intrinsic challenge and ambition of frontier engineering are fundamental to the value of large-scale scientific exploration.
quote: the fact that it's so difficult the fact that we're overreaching is the value of things like the lhc

point: Humphrey Davy emphasized that scientific progress is threatened when people presume all natural mysteries have been solved.
quote: nothing is so dangerous to the progress of the human mind than to assume that our views of science are ultimate
